messages:
liam_procure: FYI vendor just reported thermal damage on a small pallet at FRA staging, ~12 units affected. Need to decide RMA vs crossdock rework + who eats dock/expedite costs :thinking_face:
ana_logistics: Photos + initial manifest: https://files.redwood.internal/fra/IMG_5021.zip
ana_logistics: AWB: 123-98765432, staging ID: FRA-STG-77, manifest attached to the folder
mike_sre: What's the impact on Dedicated pools? numbers please
liam_procure: Short version — we lose ~8 H100-equivalent nodes until replacements arrive. That shifts queue latency for prod-dedicated by ~15-20% for the next 48–72h. Can we drop in cloud fallback?
mike_sre: We can failover some jobs to cloud but throughput cost goes up. If replacements are >72h, we'll need to throttle batch jobs.
sara_ops: Vendor says they can crossdock and repair in EU depot but want to bill dock fee + 2x expedite for weekend handling. They're offering a 70% credit on DOA units after inspection.
liam_procure: 70% is not acceptable for expedited replacements. We asked for full credit or loaner coverage until RMA completes. Vendor, can you confirm scope? @vendor_nova
vendor_nova: hi all :wave: we can cover outbound freight for RMA collections and the inspection fee. Dock handling fee is charged by depot partner. We can waive dock fee if claim photos + BOL prove thermal damage on arrival and lab confirms. We can also offer temporary loaners for a 14-day window if customer signs expedited addendum.
ana_logistics: We have inbound photos showing heat scorch on boxes and bent heatsink fins. I uploaded compressed photos. We also have serials that don't match node tags in staging — I suspect pallet shuffle during transfer. Here's the list:
```
Serials:
SN-A100-21X, SN-A100-21Y, SN-B200-991, SN-B200-992, SN-C300-145..SN-C300-156
Node tags observed vs expected:
node-tag-045 -> SN-B200-991 (expected SN-A100-21X)
node-tag-046 -> SN-A100-21Y (expected SN-B200-992)
```
liam_procure: That mismatch is the core problem — provisioning fallthroughs earlier this week referenced the same tags. If the vendor's RMA process reassigns serials, our inventory will end up inconsistent and Dedicated scheduling will serve wrong model variants.
mike_sre: We rely on tag->serial mapping for pinning model quantized builds. If mapping changes, some nodes will serve incompatible binaries; risk of crashes. We need certificate of serial reconciliation before reentering nodes into pools.
vendor_nova: Understood. We can provide a consolidated BOL and a verified serial reconciliation sheet prior to re-release. For claims on thermal damage we need photos + intake report from our depot within 48h.
nana_logistics: Depot-bot created intake ticket: RMA RN-5021.
dept-bot: RMA RN-5021 created by ana_logistics for FRA-STG-77. ETA pickup 2024-11-06.
liam_procure: ETA 11/06 is fine for standard RMA but too slow for Dedicated SLA. Vendor — can you expedite replacements or provide loaners that match our node tagging scheme (including custom tag metadata) to avoid reimaging overhead?
vendor_nova: We can expedite a partial set of loaners (up to 6 units) from EU buffer if addendum accepted. Loaners will be pre-tagged with your metadata; we need PO amendment and short PO for loaner cost holdback (refundable).
finance_julia: Can we approve a refundable holdback for up to $120k to secure loaners? Need invoice line items and credit terms.
liam_procure: If vendor will fully waive dock fee upon confirmed thermal arrival, and provide loaners pre-tagged, finance can approve refundable holdback. Vendor to send amended PO + BOL consolidation and explicit SLA for loaner handover.
vendor_nova: I'll send amended PO and agreement tonight. We'll also include a CSV with serial->node-tag mapping and a bridge script for inventory reconciliation.
mike_sre: Request that vendor-supplied CSV includes a checksum and a small script example to apply mappings: e.g.,
```
# apply_mapping.sh (example)
while IFS=, read -r TAG SERIAL; do
  inventoryctl map --tag "$TAG" --serial "$SERIAL"
done < vendor_mapping.csv
```
sara_ops: Quick ops note — do not reintroduce units into production until inventory reconciliation step complete + SRE signoff. Also we should snapshot model binaries pinned to those hosts.
nana_logistics: I'll hold off crossdock until vendor PO and CSV arrive. Will also escalate to depot manager about the pallet shuffle.
liam_procure: Summary / next steps: 1) vendor to provide amended PO + loaner addendum + BOL consolidation tonight; 2) vendor to waive dock fee conditional on photos + lab confirmation; 3) vendor to provide serial->tag CSV + script + checksum; 4) finance to provision refundable holdback if PO matches terms; 5) SRE to gate re-entry after reconciliation. Everyone ok? :thumbsup:
finance_julia: ok pending invoice detail :+1:
mike_sre: will block re-entry until reconciliation verified :lock:
sara_ops: thanks — I'll track incident and notify customers if SLA impact exceeds 24h :eyes:
vendor_nova: sending docs now, will follow up in thread with AWB consolidation and expected loaner pickup slot.
liam_procure: thanks. keeping this thread as the source of truth.
